mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stellar_browse_history (user_id, spu_id, sku_id, browse_time, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{spuId}, #{skuId}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE browse_time = NOW(), sku_id = VALUES(sku_id)
mapper.select: SELECT h.id, h.spu_id, h.sku_id, s.name AS spu_name, s.main_image AS spu_image, s.min_price AS min_price, s.status AS spu_status, h.browse_time FROM stellar_browse_history h LEFT JOIN stellar_spu s ON s.id = h.spu_id WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY h.browse_time DESC, h.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stellar_browse_history WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM stellar_browse_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id}
